subject: general
question: To which of the following communities living in western Rajasthan on the border of the Thar desert has conservation of forest and wildlife been a religious tenet ?
solution:
The correct answer is __"**Bishnoi community**".__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bishnoi** community** resides **in **western Rajasthan**, close to the boundary with the **Thar desert**.
 
• They are people who **value nature**, and **protecting forest **wildlife has always been one of their core values.
 
• They adhere to the **fundamental belief **that all living creatures have the entitlement to **survival and resource sharing**.
 
• They have **sacrificed **their** lives** to preserve the plants and animals in order **to safeguard the environment.**
 
• An **Amrita Devi** Bishnoi National **Honor** for environmental protection was established by the** Indian government.**
 
• This accolade is given in honor of Amrita Devi Bishnoi, who gave her life, together with 363 others, in 1731 to preserve the **Khejri trees** in the **Rajasthani settlement **of Khejrali, close to Jodhpur.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: *Bishnoi community*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 __**Community**__
 __**Description**__
 
 

 **Vaishya community**
 
 
 
• The status of someone being "twice-born," is **shared** by the Vaishyas with the two upper ranks of religious **Brahmans **and the powerful **Kshatriyas**—after they take on the holy woolen thread during the **upanayana ritual.**
 
• This is when they experience their spiritual reincarnation. History has attributed the Vaishyas with helping **Buddhism** and **Jainism**, two reformist religions, **grow**.
 
 
 
 

 **Chhipa community**
 
 
 
• The Chhipa is a group of people that specialize in clothing **coloring and dying**. They are Rajputs.
 
• The community was first discovered in **Rajasthan's Nagaur.**
 
• Following their relocation to Rajasthan and Gujarat, the tribe started a business that involved printing and dying clothing.
 
• The population, which is primarily found in Rajasthan, **speaks Marwari**.
 
 
 
 

 **Bhil community**
 
 
 
• One of the biggest** tribal **populations is the Bhil, who are found in the states of Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The Bhil are renowned for being **skilled archers **who are also quite knowledgeable about their immediate surroundings.
 
• Today, the majority of them work as **farmers** and farm laborers. Additionally, they are **adept sculptors.**
